note: Written before any fine-tuning and before any model was run on these sentences. One casual first-person sentence per case, in everyday wording, across finance and data, IT, and other work. Labels are the O*NET 31.0 activities a person would accept as describing the sentence, chosen by searching activity names by keyword, never with the encoder. Synthetic and agent-written; not used for training, tuning or choosing hyperparameters. Gate: a fine-tuned model ships only if it has a correct activity in the top five for more cases than the shipped base model and does not lower the S2-K7 chain regression.

cases.text: At the end of every month I match the bank statement against our own records.
I chase customers to pay their overdue invoices.
I work out the salaries and overtime for our twelve staff every month.
I key the receipts and bills into the accounting software.
I put together a monthly sheet showing where the money went.
I work out how much income tax my relatives owe each year.
I check staff expense claims before they get paid out.
I plan the yearly budget for the shop with my aunt.
I tidy up messy sales spreadsheets so the numbers can be used.
I make charts from our sales numbers for the weekly meeting.
I look at which products sell best each season to decide what to stock.
I pull customer lists out of the database with simple SQL.
I check loan applications to see if people can afford the repayments.
At closing I count the cash drawer and note any difference.
I explain the different insurance plans to my friends so they can pick one.
I keep track of stock levels and order more when we run low.

I hand out surveys to our customers and add up the answers.

I record every sale in a notebook and total it at night.
I set up user accounts and reset passwords for staff who get locked out.
I set up new laptops for people who join the company.
I run the cables and plug in the switches for the office network.
I keep the antivirus up to date on all our computers.

I fix bugs in our small booking app.
I try out new features on the website before they go live.

I calm down angry customers and sort out their complaints.
I fix leaking pipes and taps in people's homes.
I wire up sockets and lights in new houses.
I paint walls and patch up cracks in the plaster.
I fix motorbike engines at my uncle's workshop.
I weld metal frames for gates and fences.
I drive the forklift to move pallets around the warehouse.
I show new cashiers how to use the till.
